# The icons this app draws, named the way Discourse names them.
#
# `dart run tool/gen_icons.dart` reads this list, pulls each symbol out of
# Discourse's own sprites and writes lib/src/theme/d_icons.dart. Add a line
# here and re-run it rather than hand-editing the generated file.
#
# Naming follows SvgSprite.prepare_symbol: a bare name is Font Awesome solid,
# `far-` is regular, `fab-` is brands, and anything else comes from
# discourse-additional.svg. `name = other` records one of Discourse's own icon
# aliases (its REPLACEMENTS table) so payloads that use the alias resolve too.

envelope

globe

# --- Aliases, from Discourse's REPLACEMENTS in lib/icon-library.js
d-liked = heart
d-unliked = far-heart
d-tracking = bell
d-regular = far-bell
d-watching = discourse-bell-exclamation
d-muted = discourse-bell-slash
# What the chat plugin's own chat-setup.js replaces it with.
d-chat = comment
topic.closed = lock
topic.opened = unlock
category.restricted = lock
sidebar.all_categories = list
user_menu.replies = reply
user_menu.drafts = pencil
notification.mentioned = at
notification.group_mentioned = users
notification.replied = reply
notification.edited = pencil
notification.liked = heart
notification.liked_consolidated = heart
notification.quoted = quote-right
notification.chat_quoted = quote-right
notification.private_message = envelope
notification.invited_to_private_message = envelope
notification.invited_to_topic = hand-point-right
notification.invitee_accepted = user
notification.granted_badge = certificate
notification.linked = link
notification.linked_consolidated = link
notification.moved_post = right-from-bracket
notification.topic_reminder = far-clock
notification.bookmark_reminder = discourse-bookmark-clock
notification.group_message_summary = users
notification.post_approved = check
notification.membership_request_accepted = user-plus
notification.membership_request_consolidated = users
notification.reaction = discourse-emojis
notification.votes_released = plus
# Discourse also maps notification.posted, .watching_category_or_tag and
# .watching_first_post onto discourse-bell-exclamation and discourse-bell-one,
# which are not in the sprites this generator reads. NotificationDescription
# names an icon for those three itself.
